code='''def transform(grid):\n    hflip = [row[::-1] for row in grid]\n    vflip = grid[::-1]\n    rot180 = [row[::-1] for row in vflip]\n    return [\n        rot180[r] + vflip[r] + rot180[r] for r in range(len(grid))\n    ] + [\n        hflip[r] + grid[r] + hflip[r] for r in range(len(grid))\n    ] + [\n        rot180[r] + vflip[r] + rot180[r] for r in range(len(grid))\n    ]\n'''
